name: haya-nur
description: Haya Nur — modest ethnic wear storefront (React SPA + Express API + MongoDB) with WhatsApp ordering and a protected admin panel

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n db,server,client -c magenta,yellow,cyan "npm run dev:db -w server" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
